chunks: Abu Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) said to me, “O Jabir, indeed Allah, the first thing He created, created Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his progeny, the guiding ones, the guided ones. So they were phantoms of light before Allah.” I said, “What are the phantoms?” He said, “The shadow of light: luminous bodies without spirits, and he was supported by one spirit, and that is the Spirit of Holiness.”

So by it he worshipped Allah, and his progeny, and for that reason He created them forbearing, learned, righteous, pure ones. They worship Allah through salat (prayer), sawm (fasting), sajdah (prostration), tasbih (glorification), and tahlil, and they perform the prayers, perform hajj, and fast.

key_terms.الْهُدَاةَ: the guides who lead creation to truth
key_terms.رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ: the Holy Spirit by which divine support is given
key_terms.عِتْرَتَهُ: his progeny, referring to the family of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.نُورٍ: light, indicating a luminous primordial mode of creation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the pre-eternal creation of Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the primordial creation of Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his purified progeny as beings of light, supported by the Holy Spirit before earthly embodiment. It emphasizes their exalted ontological rank and their constant devotion to Allah through acts of worship.
